themes: Indonesia's energy transition hinges on PLN's capex cycle and feed-in tariff revisions, making policy clarity the dominant swing factor for local renewables valuations.
US solar demand is structurally supported by IRA subsidies and grid-scale backlog, insulating SEDG/ENPH from near-term rate volatility.

sectors.ai: US-listed renewables rebounded on rate-cut hopes while Indonesian names lagged on rupiah weakness and policy uncertainty. Buy US solar equipment (SEDG, ENPH) for near-term beta, but rotate into Indonesian utilities (HGII) only after clarity on PLN procurement and tariff reform. Hedge IDR exposure via NRG-style cash-flow names.

Digital distribution and direct-to-consumer channels are structurally lowering customer acquisition costs for agile mid-cap FMCG firms, enabling faster market share gains versus legacy giants.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names with strong earnings momentum (BIKE, POLU, AGAR) despite sector softness; the -0.83% aggregate masks sharp divergence, with ID underperforming US. Favor exporters and niche food/beverage plays benefiting from rupiah weakness and domestic resilience. Trim large-cap staples with US exposure; rotate into high-volume movers showing institutional accumulation. Maintain WATCH but act on relative strength within 48 hours.
